Feeds

A feed is a secret address any calendar app can subscribe to (webcal), without an account. Anyone with the address sees the calendar, or only when you are busy; a new address or revoking it stops the old one at once.

Calendar Whole calendar Busy times only
Personal
Work Calendar

Subscriptions

A subscription is a read-only calendar filled from a feed elsewhere (a school's holidays, a team's fixtures), fetched again every hour or as often as the feed asks.

Birthdays

Show your contacts' birthdays and anniversaries in a read-only calendar.

CalDAV Access

Configure your CalDAV client with:

  • Server: your-server-url
  • Path: /remote.php/dav
  • Username/Password: your Cog credentials or an app password
